title: Undergraduate Research and Fellowships Mentoring (URFM) — Penn State
description: URFM is Penn State's central undergraduate research office. title: Rodney A. Erickson Discovery Grant (Penn State)
description: Named for Penn State's seventeenth president, the Erickson Discovery Grant funds undergraduate engagement in original research, scholarship, and creative work under the direct supervision of a research mentor; forty-three grants were awarded for summer 2024.
